status: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION PATIENT — NOT A REAL PERSON, NOT CLINICAL EVIDENCE
disclaimer: Every value here was generated by simulating the published population model against itself with a seeded RNG. It exists to drive a user-interface demonstration and to pin the numbers shown on stage to committed bytes. It is NOT evidence of anything about the model's accuracy, and no claim about predictive performance may be derived from it.
reference_instant_note: The wall-clock instant time_h = 0 maps to. agent_pk carries no wall-clock time by design; the patient interface renders local times from this.

regeneration.note: tests/test_demo_fixture.py regenerates every number below and asserts equality.

covariates.note: CYP3A5 expresser: the population this project is about. The source model parameterises on carriers, so 26.5 L/h IS the expresser value.
covariates.haematocrit_note: DECLARED, not defaulted. This build does not assume anaemia, and it does not leave the haematocrit unmeasured either — it states the assumption. 0.45 is the reference value the source model standardised to, so the correction is exactly the identity here and no demo number depends on it. In real use the clinician supplies the measured value and the correction does real work; leaving it out entirely marks the prior haematocrit_known=False and warns, because an unmeasured anaemia makes the model read fast clearance and UNDERSTATE the probability of a sub-therapeutic trough.

true_parameters.note: The truth the synthetic data was generated from, used ONLY to guard this fixture in the test suite against drifting into a flattering fiction. NEVER RENDERED ON STAGE and never quoted as a result: an accuracy figure obtained by simulating our own model against itself, on a patient we generated, is not a measurement. Show the interval narrowing and the probability of target attainment instead — neither needs a truth value to be meaningful. A real patient has no such field.

population_model.citation: Fernandez-Alarcon B, et al. Guiding the starting dose of the once-daily formulation of tacrolimus in de novo adult renal transplant patients: a population approach. Front Pharmacol 2024;15:1456565. doi:10.3389/fphar.2024.1456565

band.citation: Fernandez-Alarcon B, et al. Front Pharmacol 2024;15:1456565 — the SAME study this project's population prior is taken from: 'a predefined therapeutic target of 5-10 ng/mL' in de novo adult renal transplant recipients on ADVAGRAF (Astellas), the once-daily prolonged-release formulation.
band.caveat: CORRECTED 2026-09-09. The previous band (4-11 ng/mL) was cited from a Phase III LCPT (MeltDose, Envarsus XR) protocol — a DIFFERENT once-daily product from the one this model describes, and not bioequivalent to it: LCPT has materially higher bioavailability and a later Tmax, so its trough targets do not transfer. Reference range and PK model must come from the same formulation or the comparison is meaningless. A real band is centre- and patient-specific and belongs in the care plan; this published target stands in for one the demo does not have, and it is now at least the target for the right drug.

care_plan.note: The clinician-authored half of the demo case. It lives in the FIXTURE rather than in code because the software may not author it: plan_text_from_clinician is carried verbatim into the patient channel, where what makes it permissible under 21 U.S.C. 360j(o)(1)(D) is that a clinician wrote it about their own patient. A string generated by the application and shown in that slot would be the software telling a patient what to do, which is the one thing the patient channel may not do. This text is written as a fictional clinician's words for a synthetic patient.
care_plan.plan_text_from_clinician: Take your tablet at the same time every morning, on an empty stomach, and wait an hour before eating. If you are sick within an hour of taking it, or you start any new medicine from anyone, tell us the same day. We will let you know if we need a blood test sooner than planned.
care_plan.band_citation_ref_note: The range and its citation are NOT duplicated here. They live under `band`, which is the one place this fixture states them, and the loader reads them from there.

doses_note: Thirty days of delivered once-daily doses PLUS the scheduled next dose at 720 h, which the forecast requires and refuses without.
troughs_note: Four monthly-style pre-dose troughs, the routine monitoring this product starts from.
measured_curve_note: MEASURED C0/C1/C3/C6 around the dose at 696 h — never the model's own predictions, which would compare the model with itself.

interacting_drug.note: The step-6 demo drug. Look it up through agent_pk.interactions for its direction, mechanism and citations. Not applied to these numbers: this fixture holds the patient's parameters CONSTANT, and a genuine within-patient change is a separate demo beat that triggers re-sampling.
